title: Achalasia Patient Reported Outcomes
brief_summary: Patients that are either scheduled to undergo or have undergone an achalasia procedure at the Mayo Clinic Rochester are asked to participate. The purpose of this study is to gather information and determine if one of these procedures is superior to the other.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>18 years old
* Undergoing a POEM or laparoscopic modified heller myotomy and anti-reflux procedures
* Esophagus diameter less \<8 cm on barium swallow test

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Diverticular disease of the esophagus
* Barrett's esophagus
* Extensive abdominal adhesions
* \<50% predicted FEV1 on pulmonary function testing
* Cardiac ejection fraction \<25%
* Esophageal stricture from prior myotomy
* Sigmoidization of the esophagus
* More than one prior balloon dilation (\>3 cm) or any prior dilation of 3 cm
study_population: Patients undergoing PerOral Endoscopic Myotomy (POEM) or Laparoscopic Modified Heller Myotomy and Anti-Reflux Procedures at Mayo Clinic Rochester
